content:
Overview

Overland Park is a city in KS with a population of 197,000. Kansas City’s largest suburb with top-rated schools, corporate parks, and family appeal. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
